remarks: OPPORTUNITY KNOCKS! Prime Location! This property offers a fantastic opportunity to renovate, expand, or build anew in a picturesque, park-like setting with stone walls and mature trees, spanning just over 2 acres. Available for the first time in over 40 years, the property includes an oversized ranch on a beautiful 2-acre lot. The ranch requires significant work. It has the potential to be restored to its original charm or replaced with a magnificent estate. The neighborhood features high-end homes and is conveniently close to the NY line. A map and survey are attached. The house is being sold "as is" and awaits the vision of new buyers.
